name: serverkit-faro
description: One-click Open in Faro, plus time-boxed access grants. Adds a Connect with Faro button to Services, Domains, and WordPress sites that opens the Faro desktop client prefilled to SFTP into that site's web root, via faro:// deep links — no credentials ever leave the panel: a link only prefills Faro's connection editor. It can also issue Faro access grants (faro://grant): hand someone revocable, key-based SSH/SFTP access to a bundle of managed servers with a single link — Faro fetches the grant manifest from this panel, uploads a freshly-generated public key after the user accepts, and this extension installs that key on the granted servers. Revoking the grant removes the key; the owner's own credentials are never touched.
author: Juan Denis
